identity.lineage: From the restart the owner asked for on 2 Oct 2026 (every rule, plus weekends off as spread as the cover weeks allow, which is five weeks apart). The weeks were searched from random starts with the weekend gap capped at five (anneal.mjs), then polished with Second Nature and Second Wind's figures as floors (space-polish.mjs). One of the two rotas in that search to meet every floor, four single rest days included. It keeps the 42 late finishes a year and has one week mixing earlies and lates; its heaviest week is 43h 40m.
